rationale: C04 plausibly supplied concrete language and policy framing for the later letter. Both address Federal assistance to areas of substantial, persistent, or chronic unemployment; emphasize State, local, and private participation; identify the Small Business Investment Act lending program for State and local development companies; assign an area-development role to the Department of Commerce; and close by urging Congress to enact additional area-assistance legislation. C22 is also closely related and supplies specific labor-surplus procurement actions later reported as part of the Federal effort, while C06 offers a similar long-form status-report structure and overlapping small-business and procurement material. C04, however, has the strongest combined literal and substantive correspondence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: areas with substantial and persistent unemployment
shared_material.parent_excerpt: communities of substantial and persistent unemployment
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared description of the target communities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A new lending authority of the Small Business Administration provided for by the Small Business Investment Act of 1958 allows the making of mortgage loans ... to state and local development companies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the new program of loans to State and local development companies under the Small Business Investment Act of 1958
shared_material.explanation: Both identify the same specific administrative mechanism as existing Federal assistance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: full cooperation by these Federal agencies with state and local governments and private individuals and organizations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the major responsibility for planning and financing the economic redevelopment ... must remain with local citizens if federal programs are to be effective
shared_material.explanation: Parallel policy machinery stressing Federal aid coordinated with local and private responsibility.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Office of Area Development in the Department of Commerce has been channelling Federal technical assistance to state and local groups
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Such a program should be lodged ... with the Department of Commerce which has primary responsibility for business and industrial development and a long experience in extending to local areas technical aid
shared_material.explanation: Both assign Commerce a central technical-assistance role in area redevelopment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have repeatedly urged that the Congress pass legislation which I have specifically proposed to assist areas of urgent need
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my intention ... to request the Congress to enact area assistance legislation
shared_material.explanation: The later letter reuses the earlier memorandum's legislative appeal as its closing policy point.
